releaseNotes:
_Date: 2026-05-18_

---

### ✨ What's New

#### 🖥 Full-Screen Chat Workspace & Directory Browser
Compass Partner now includes a **full-screen workspace** for chat-focused flows, with a built-in **directory browser** that makes it easier to navigate project folders and move between chat and file context without leaving the workspace.

- **Full-screen chat workspace** — a dedicated expanded view gives chats more room for long conversations, previews, and file-driven work.
- **Integrated directory browser** — you can browse folders directly inside the workspace instead of juggling external file explorers.
- **Cleaner preview flow** — the old Preview sidebar entry has been removed and replaced with a simpler **Back to Chat** navigation path.
- **Design gallery polish** — related design-gallery and layout fixes improve responsiveness and reduce UI friction across the new workspace.

#### 🔌 Better Device Management Feedback
Device connection flows are now clearer and less error-prone when working with paired devices and folder channels.

- **Connected state in the device menu** — channels that already have an active device grant now show **Connected** immediately.
- **New device info dialog** — paired-device details are easier to inspect without leaving the current workflow.
- **Cleaner transient messaging** — status messages now dismiss automatically, reducing clutter during pairing and grant operations.

---

### 🛠 Improvements

- **Voice and remote-agent settings refined** — visibility rules in Settings are cleaner, so voice controls and remote-agent options appear more appropriately.
- **Ultra-wide screen layout improved** — chat bubble sizing now behaves better on very large displays.
- **Marketplace sources UI tidied up** — the empty state and section labelling are clearer in Settings.
- **Tool-call time display improved** — `get_world_time` results now surface timezone information more clearly in chat.

---

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Fixed **recovery after system sleep/resume** — the app now reconnects more reliably when the machine wakes up.
- Fixed **channel cleanup on chat deletion** — A2A teardown is more robust when removing chats.
- Fixed **scheduler group labels** — custom folder names are now shown instead of raw paths.
- Fixed **scheduler History expansion state** — expanded/collapsed state now persists like it does in the Tasks tab.
- Fixed **redundant OneDrive breadcrumb** in the Microsoft 365 import dialog.
- Fixed **tool-call pulse animation glitches** in chat.

---

_Co-authored by [Nova](https://www.compassap.ai/portfolio/nova.html)_
